# Ordinary register first-read reuse proof

Run `python3 tests/test_webrcade_ps2_register_reuse.py --play /path/to/installed5833/Play --output /empty/private/output` from the repository. The supplied Play is read only and must retain its Framework archive. The pinned, offline Emscripten SDK compiles all twelve generic/Wasm CodeGen translation units and CMipsJitter fresh for each variant; actual VUShared/FpUtils are compiled at link. No Play/full-core build is performed.

The fixture uses actual wasm32 CMIPS/MIPSSTATE offsets, ordinary GPR/VF registers1–31, four exact operand types, overlaps and masked writes, all reference-store widths, calls with actual generated reentry, branches/loops, registerzero/VF0/scratch/ACC exclusions, recursive MakeSz temporary input cones, SELECT order, arithmetic read-modify-write, prior-operand traps, and same-backend enable/disable/enable. Full memory, raw NaN/signed-zero bits, canaries, and ordered helper/store observations are compared. Final-Wasm auditing compares store opcodes/attributes/address expressions in sequence; it does not claim value-expression identity. Four load-count checks prove the exact32-statement boundary, and nine keys prove the eight-local cap. All synchronization remains unchanged.

Two baseline limitations are explicit negatives, not hidden oracle exceptions: the direct all-true `MD_StoreAtRefIdxMasked` frontend calls the load frontend, so its intended full-store byte oracle fails; supported full stores use `MD_StoreAtRefIdx`. Two large unsigned relative offsets produce baseline-invalid signed-LEB encodings and remain equally invalid. Neither baseline issue is changed by this optimization.

`portable-runner.js` exposes `runPortableCorpus(corpus)` with no Node/DOM dependency. The generated portable corpus retains actual module bytes, bounded raw contexts, canaries, helper observations, reentry and trap cases for other Wasm engines. Static load/local changes and correctness results establish no performance improvement. Generated outputs remain private; no ROM or guest-code capture is used.
